pages.title: Inherited appearance
pages.subtitle: Individually shaped people, regional ancestry and cultural grooming. Native portraits in controlled lighting.

blocks.text: Generated NPCs now carry persistent skin, hair and iris pigmentation, facial proportions, stature and build. Relatives resemble each other; regional populations retain shared traits alongside individual variation.

rows: Inherited traits
Pigmentation, hair texture, facial proportions and potential adult stature.
Cultural grooming
Six overlapping categories: cropped, short, long, tied, braided and shaved.
People identity
A persistent identity separate from culture and political ownership.

blocks.text: These six portraits are real generated residents sampled from the saved world, using their own names and inherited profiles.

pages.title: Independent, adjustable traits
pages.subtitle: Synthetic parameter controls on one shared base rig. These examples are not named ethnic presets.

blocks.text: Twelve anatomical morph axes shape the face and build. Hair is fitted separately to the same head. The simulation supplies inherited ranges; cultural preferences supply the grooming distribution.

rows: Families and regions
Deterministic individual variation around regional means, with biological-parent resemblance.
Human species
Species stature provides the broad baseline; within-sapiens variation stays much narrower.
Cost
Personally shaped full, middle and far meshes are baked once when a character loads. No active runtime blendshapes.

blocks.text: The existing rigs, motion banks and source texture art are retained. No character-creation menu is added in this pass.

pages.title: One identity across gameplay
pages.subtitle: Actual-world embodiment, clothing, inventory and saved NPC context.

images.caption: The embodied resident, inherited portrait, fitted coat and retained tools.
Controlled gathering: 100 sampled people from seven bands.

blocks.text: The inherited person is used in the world, first person, the inventory portrait, local NPC memory and save files. Dialogue context receives the actual hair and eye description.

rows: Inheritance and identity
5,810 core checks; family variation, cultural independence, copying and bounded species size.
Native portraits
716 checks /30 profiles /120 poses; actual combat skins agree with bone matrices within one micrometre.
Played-world integration
19 checks: embodiment, camera/capsule height, portrait anatomy and pigmentation, clothing, full session serialization.
Existing gameplay
184 combat/item, 35 clothing and 86 animation checks passed.
100-NPC close crowd
118.6 /117.8 FPS; p99 ~11.6 ms; longest frames 22-29 ms. Strict 100-FPS floor remains unmet.

blocks.text: Crowd: medium 1080p, 6 km view and four 30-second windows, with Chrome/video in use. Original source art is retained. Fuller beard variants and individual limb proportions remain future work.
